current.pf_faq_1_q: How do I pick my size?
current.pf_faq_1_a: For the Knee Sleeve, pick your size by body weight, from S (110 to 130 lbs) to 4XL (301+ lbs). Not sure? Write us before you order.
current.pf_faq_2_q: Can I change how tight it feels?
current.pf_faq_2_a: Yes. Make it tighter for stairs and long walks, and looser when your knee feels swollen. It only takes a few seconds.
current.pf_faq_3_q: How long can I wear it?
current.pf_faq_3_a: All day. Take it off at night. If anything feels numb or tingly, loosen it a little.
current.pf_faq_4_q: Will it help if my knee is "bone on bone"?
current.pf_faq_4_a: Many people with bone-on-bone knees wear it for extra steadiness when they move. It won't repair cartilage, but support that keeps the knee steadier can make stairs and walks feel more comfortable. If you're unsure, ask your doctor.
current.pf_faq_5_q: When will I feel a difference?
current.pf_faq_5_a: Most people notice the extra support the first time they walk in it. Give it a few days of regular wear to find the fit that feels best for you.
current.pf_faq_6_q: What if it doesn't work for me?
current.pf_faq_6_a: You're covered by our 90-day money-back guarantee, starting the day your order arrives. Email us at info@trypeakflex.com and we'll walk you through it.
current.pf_faq_7_a: Orders leave in 1 to 3 business days. US delivery usually takes 5 to 12 business days, and you get a tracking number by email.
current.pf_faq_8_q: Which product is right for me?
current.pf_faq_8_a: Start with where it hurts. For knees, most people pick the PeakFlex Knee Sleeve. For feet, the Footsleeve. For the lower back, the Orthobelt.
current.pf_faq_9_a: Hand wash in cold water and let it air dry. No dryer. Heat ruins the stretch.
